preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, where the first line is T (number of test cases), followed by T test cases, each with two lines: first line contains N and K, second line contains N space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10**5
preconditions.description: T is a positive integer within the constraint 1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]) and all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains exactly two integers N and K, and the second line contains exactly N integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N) <= 10**5 for N, K in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])) and all(1 <= int(K) <= int(N) for N, K in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and K satisfy 1 ≤ K ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(A_i) <= 10**6 for A_i in line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each element A_i in the array satisfies 1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No', 'yEs', 'nO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a string that is case-insensitive equivalent to 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line) == 2 or len(stdout_line) == 3 for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 2 or 3 characters long (e.g., 'YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no').

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.upper() == 'YES' or stdout_line.upper() == 'NO' for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line, when converted to uppercase, is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda A, K: all(A[i] == A[N - 1 - i] + (d_i - d_j) for i in range(N // 2) for j in range(N // 2) if i == j) or all(A[i] + d_i == A[N - 1 - i] + d_j for i in range(N // 2) for j in range(N // 2) for d_i in range(0, max_diff + 1) for d_j in range(0, max_diff + 1) if (d_i - d_j) % K == 0 and (d_i - d_j) >= 0))(list(map(int, line.split())), int(K)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]) if stdout_line.upper() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a way to make the array A palindromic by incrementing K distinct indices any number of times. This is true if for every pair of symmetric indices (i, N-1-i), the difference (A[i] - A[N-1-i]) is divisible by K and non-negative, or if the differences can be balanced by incrementing the appropriate indices.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda A, K: any((A[i] - A[N - 1 - i]) % K == 0 and (A[i] - A[N - 1 - i]) >= 0 for i in range(N // 2)) or all((A[i] - A[N - 1 - i]) % K == 0 and (A[i] - A[N - 1 - i]) >= 0 for i in range(N // 2))) for N, A, K in [(int(N), list(map(int, line.split())), int(K)) for line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2])]) if stdout_line.upper() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if for every pair of symmetric indices (i, N-1-i), the difference (A[i] - A[N-1-i]) is non-negative and divisible by K. This ensures that the required increments can be applied to make the array palindromic.
